why: UNIVERSES: A is the conjunction of the 36 listed theorems at universe 0 (continuousOn_snd_comp_of_isFaceScPlusSectionOn at .{0}; the FaceCorner/QuadrantBundle examples have no universe parameter); B is on SEP.{0}. B's first part is Theorem 14.6.3 for a compatible assignment of classes (IsCompatibleAssignment: Definition 14.6.2 with the equivalence of Definition 13.3.8, which compares functors, index sets and correspondences but not sections), asking for a structured Λ̃ over ∂X with Λ|F = Λ_F. As we read it B does not hold: on the project's corner example W = X × ℝ² → X = [0,∞)² × ℝ (tame, face-structured) the assignment Λt is compatible, yet no functor agreeing with the Λ_F over the faces is an sc⁺-multisection over ∂X (signs ±(h(t),x₂) and ±(g(t),x₁) cannot be matched continuously around the corner). not_B re-proves this without the item's theorems (copies of isEpFace_subset_coord, exists_isEpFace_mem_of_part, continuousOn_snd_comp_of_isFaceScPlusSectionOn, subset_Z_one, isCompatibleAssignment_Λt, not_isBoundaryScPlusMultisection_of_eq_on_faces from non-item lemmas); classStatement_to_notB shows A's own conjunct not_theorem_14_6_3_class_statement refutes B, so the two sides agree on the corner. Hence A ⇒ B does not hold (not_A_to_B) and B ⇒ A holds only ex falso. The project's statements of Theorem 14.6.3 that hold require the faces' representatives to agree with their sections on F ∩ F' (CompatibleFaceData, SectionCompatibleFaceData/Families, IsSecCompatibleAssignment on classes modulo the equivalence with sections), the property the text uses on p. 682; B's extension part (Theorem 14.1.9) is not reached because the first part already has no witness.
B_issue: B's compatibility hypothesis is the project's IsCompatibleAssignment (classes modulo Definition 13.3.8, sections not compared), the literal reading of Definition 14.6.2; under it the conclusion does not hold at the corner example. B's extension clause uses the hypotheses of the project's theorem_14_1_9_statement.

Every term mentioning A reaches CompatibleFaceData.Λg_eq, τg_eq, Φ_eq and RelTuple.Equiv.cast_smul through the bodies of the vocabulary definitions CompatibleFaceData.S and CompatibleFaceData.tau (used directly in structure fields, not as _proof_ terms), so #rt_check and #rt_check_soft cannot pass on B_to_A or A_to_notB (recorded with #guard_msgs, dropping the messages); their content is carried by not_B and classStatement_to_notB. rt_overlap not_B: 1338 shared project theorems: the corner example's non-banned helpers (φ₁_eq_or, signMulti_congr, exists_sign_of_signMulti_ne_zero, exists_sign_endpoints, path₁/path₂ lemmas, hfun/gfun, contDiff_germMap, signTuple), Example 11.1.4 and the quadrant face machinery (dq_eq_one_iff, faceAt_subset_coord_eq_zero, exists_isFaceIn_univ_preimage), chart₀ and the strong-bundle/natural-representation vocabulary. not_B depends on propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

main.note: main holds and B does not, so main ⇒ B does not hold; B ⇒ main only ex falso (B_to_main, rt_check OK). The hypotheses differ: main assumes compatibility of classes modulo the equivalence with sections (FaceSecMultisection, IsSecCompatibleAssignment), B the equivalence without sections.
